title: Estimation and Capacity
subtitle: From users to QPS to servers: get the order of magnitude, then add peak and headroom
motto: Size for the peak, not the average, and be right to within 2x
coreAddition: estimation chain with peak factor and napkin grading
keyInsight: A fleet sized for average traffic runs at nearly three times capacity at peak, and a guess within 2x picks the same architecture as an exact answer, so estimate the order of magnitude and size for the peak.

decisions.title: Show sizing for the average as the failure
decisions.description: The failure frame sizes the fleet for average traffic and reports the load at peak, so the peak factor is justified by a number rather than a rule.
decisions.alternatives: Stating 'always multiply by 3' would give the rule without showing what skipping it costs.

decisions.title: Grade the guess like the napkin quiz
decisions.description: The last frame applies the app's 2x and 10x grading to a guess expressed as a multiple of the truth, so a sloppy estimate is scored the same way as in practice.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting only the exact answer would hide that the order of magnitude is what matters.
